hook: Drawn from the round sun: the sun, its sunshine, and each day it brings.
Sun (日) shining through the gap of a gate (門): the space in between.
Steam rising up: invisible energy inside you, your spirit and mood.
A hand holding a tool at work: the things and matters you deal with.
Looks like a baby with arms out and a wrapped body: a child.
A person going (彳) over there: that man, he, or your boyfriend.
Bright (明) + day (日): the bright new day ahead, tomorrow.
Meet (会) + discuss (議): people meet to discuss things, a meeting.
Looks like a thin crescent moon: the moon.
Most (最) + behind (後): the one furthest behind, the last.
That (彼) woman (女): she, or your girlfriend.
Return (帰): the trip back home.
Most (最) + first time (初): the very first, the beginning.
Try (試) + test (験): trying yourself out in a test, an exam.
Ten (十) parts (分) out of ten: full, that is enough.
One (一) time (度): once.
Department (部) + chief (長): the head of a department.
Sounds like 'hen': a hen in your bedroom is strange.
Link (連) + tie together (絡): linking up with someone, making contact.
Ancestor (祖) + mother (母): the mother before your parents, grandmother.
Explain (説) + clear (明): explaining until it is clear.
Try (試) + match up (合): testing your skill against others, a match.
Mouth (口) + not yet (未): what your mouth checks before swallowing, taste.
Logic (理) + from (由): the logic something comes from, the reason.
Ancestor (祖) + father (父): the father before your parents, grandfather.
Three trees (木) together: lots of trees make a forest.
Each (各) person who comes under your roof (宀): a guest or customer.
Return (返) + thing (事): the thing you send back, a reply.
Lose (失) + be defeated (敗): losing and being beaten, a failure.
Most (最) + near (近): the nearest times to now, recently.
Must (必) + need (要): something you must have, necessary.
Plant top (艹) and tree (木) bottom: what grows on plants and trees, a leaf.
From (以) + above (上): from this point up, more than; also 'that is all'.
Looks like a heart with drops around it: your heart and mind.
Stand (立) on a tree (木) and see (見): a parent watching over their child.
Place (場) + place (所): two 'place' kanji, so a location.
Sounds like 'oh, toe!': the sound you make when you hit your toe.
A field (田) over the heart (心): thoughts growing in your heart, to think.
Thread (糸) + winter (冬): the year's thread runs out in winter, the end.
Stop (止) right at the line (一): stopping exactly where you should, correct.
Promise (約) + bundle (束): tying words together into a promise.
Bamboo (竹) + fit (合): a bamboo slip that fits the question, the answer.
Company (社) + chief (長): the head of the company, the president.
Measure (計) + draw (画): measuring and drawing things out, a plan.
A child (子) under a roof (宀) learning to write: a letter or character.
Heart (心) + hand out (配): your heart spread over many troubles, worry.
Life (生) + lively (活): living your everyday life.
Sounds like 'cue': on cue, suddenly, everyone must hurry.
Sounds like 'typhoon', and has wind (風) in it: a typhoon.
Thing (事) + mishap (故): something that goes wrong, an accident.
Beforehand (予) + fix (定): things fixed in advance, your plans.
Carry (運) + turn (転): turning the wheel to carry people, driving.
Spirit (気) + hold (持): the mood you hold inside, a feeling.
Meet (会): people meeting together, a meeting or gathering.
Person (亻) + servant: once a humble word for servant, now a boy's or man's 'I'.
Against (反) + facing (対): facing against something, opposition.
Beforehand (予) + promise (約): promising a place in advance, a reservation.
Generation (世) + boundary (界): everything within the borders, the world.
Use (用): something you need to use your time on, an errand.
Capital (都): the big city, as in 東京都, Tokyo Metropolis.
Woman (女) + nature or sex (性): a polite word for a woman.
Translate (訳): turning words into sense, so the reason or explanation.
Idea (意) + see (見): how you see an idea, your opinion.
Looks like a strong arm flexing: strength, power.
An old man (耂) thinking for a long time: to think about, consider.
House (家): someone at home in one field, like 作家 (writer) or 画家 (painter).
Must (必): it must happen, surely, without fail.
Place (場) + fit (合): the place and time that fits, the case or situation.
Standard (準) + equip (備): getting equipped up to standard, preparing.
Value (値) + step (段): the step or level of value, the price.
Near (近) + place (所): the places near you, the neighbourhood.
Simple (簡) + single (単): simple and single, easy.
Now (今) + time (度): this time, or the next time coming.
Flip (翻) + translate (訳): flipping words over into another language.
Rays shining out from the top of a person (儿): light.
Season (季) + section (節): a section of the year, a season.
Manners (礼): a thank you or small gift that shows good manners.
Looks like a flame with sparks flying out: fire.
Shop (店) + member (員): a member of shop staff, a clerk.
Breath (息) + child (子): the child who carries on your breath, your son.
Meet (会) + place (場): the place where people meet, a venue.
Ahead (先) + fellows (輩): the fellows who came ahead of you, your seniors.
Warn (警) + inspect (察): the people who warn and inspect, the police.
Days (日) piled up under many layers: long ago, the old days.
Meeting (会議) + room (室): the room for meetings.
Section (課) + chief (長): the head of a section, section manager.
Small (小) + talk (説): small talk grown into a long story, a novel.
Firm (確): firm and sure, certain; 'if I remember right'.
Moving around (辶) freely: play.
A road (辶) that goes on and on: far away.
Thread (糸) that keeps going: to continue, keep up.
Polish (研) + dig deep (究): polishing and digging into a topic, research.
A big man (大) with a hairpin (extra line): a grown man, a husband.
Business (事務) + place (所): the place for business work, an office.
Eat (食) + thing (事): the act of eating, a meal.
A person (人) inside a frame (冂): inside, within.
Ground (地) + shake (震): the ground shakes, an earthquake.
A small dot or mark: a point, mark or score.
Knife (刂) cutting things apart: separate, different.
Pour (注) + mind (意): pour your mind into it, pay attention.
Way (道) + tool (具): the things you use to get work done, tools.
Fire (灬) at the bottom: heat, a fever.
Sounds like 'hajime!', the word a referee shouts to begin a match: to start.
Travel (旅) + building (館): a building for travellers, a Japanese inn.
Each other (相) + talk (談): talking things over together, consulting.
Hand (扌) on the left: the thin parts of your hand you point with, fingers.
Show (表): the side you show, the front or surface.
A rock (口) under a cliff: a stone.
Live (住) + place (所): the place where you live, your address.
Man (男) + nature or sex (性): a man, male.
Manner (様): the way or manner something looks or is done.
Skill (技) + method (術): skills and methods, technique or technology.
Meet (会) + talk (話): meeting and talking, a conversation.
See (見): something you can see, to be visible; politely, someone 'appears' (comes).
Finish (卒) + studies (業): finishing your studies, graduation.
Whole (全) + state (然): with a negative, not at all, wholly not.
Barrier (関) + link (係): what links you across a barrier, a connection.
Fun (楽): something fun you look forward to.
Carry (運) + move (動): moving and carrying your body, exercise.
Lose (失) + manners (礼): losing your manners, rude; also 'excuse me'.
Big (大) + thing (事): a big thing, so important.
Peaceful (寧): calm, careful and neat, so polite.
Now (今) + night (夜): this night, tonight.
Around (周): the things all around you, your surroundings.
Long time (久): it has been a long time.
Pass through (経) + test (験): the tests you passed through, experience.
God (神) + shrine (社): a shrine for the Shinto gods.
Moon (月): one moon cycle, a month.
Mud (泥) + stick (棒): a muddy man with a stick, a thief.
People (人) + mouths (口): the number of mouths to feed, the population.
Evening (夕) at the bottom: what you see in the night, a dream.
A cloth (巾) laid on a seat: a seat.
Learn (習) + get used to (慣): something learned until you are used to it, a custom.
Thread (糸) + spring (泉): a long thread like flowing water, a line.
Build (建): how a house is built, like 二階建て (two storeys).
Profit (利) + use (用): using something for its benefit.
View (景) + colour (色): the colours of the view, scenery.
Sky (空) + spirit (気): the invisible stuff in the sky, air.
Weather (天気) + beforehand (予) + report (報): a report on the weather ahead.
Straight (直): making something straight again, to fix or correct.
Back (背) + middle (中): the middle of your back.
Replace (代): someone or something that replaces, a substitute.
Introduce (紹) + go between (介): going between two people, an introduction.
City or market (市): where people gather to trade, a city.
Earth (土) + measure (寸): ground measured out for a Buddhist temple.
Woman (女) + good (良): a good young woman, a daughter.
One (一) whole life (生, 命) hung (懸) on it: putting everything in, with all your effort.
Leftover (残) + feeling (念): a feeling that stays behind, regret.
No (無) + logic (理): no reason it could work, impossible.
Plan (案) + inside (内): leading people inside with a plan, guidance.
Pass through (通): the road you pass along, a street.
Only (専) + gate (門): the one gate you go through, your speciality.
High (高) + school (校) + student (生): a high school student.
Fit together (合): to fit, to match.
Person (亻) + worry (憂): a person who worries for others, kind and gentle.
Calm (安) + whole (全): calm and in one piece, safety.
Wood (木) + friends (朋): wooden boards side by side, shelves.
Shape (形): the outer form of something.
Water (氵) + street (巷): the place where water meets the streets, a harbour.
An ear (耳) at the gate (門): sound gets through, to be heard.
University (大学) + student (生): a university student.
Time (時) + generation (代): a time of one generation, an era.
Gate (門) opening up: to open; to open an event, to hold it.
Heart (忄) + cloth (布): your heart hides under a cloth, scared.
Origin (原) + cause (因): where it all came from, the cause.
Company (社) + meeting (会): people meeting in groups, society.
A bird (鳥) on a mountain (山) in the sea: an island.
Sun (日) + born (生): little suns born in the sky, stars.
Festival (祭): a celebration for the gods, a festival.
Receive (受) + attach (付): where visitors are received and signed in, reception.
Use (用) + mind (意): keeping in mind what you will use, preparation.
Wear (着) + thing (物): the thing you wear, a kimono.
Words (言) + shoot (射): shooting out words of sorry, to apologize.
Pass through (歴) + record (史): a record of what passed, history.
Rice field (田) + cottage (舎): cottages by the fields, the countryside.
About to (将) + come (来): what is about to come, the future.
Newspaper (新聞) + company (社): a newspaper company.
Self (自) + from (由): acting from yourself alone, freedom.
Neck (首): also means head, the part that holds up your head.
Route (途) + middle (中): in the middle of the route, on the way.
Driving (運転) + hand (手): the hands on the wheel, a driver.
